description: This file defines a Blazor component called ToastComponent, which handles displaying toast notifications within a web application. It subscribes to toast events from a ToastService and shows/hides toasts accordingly, customizing appearance based on toast level.

classes.name: ToastComponent
classes.description: A Blazor component responsible for rendering toast notifications, with methods to show and hide toasts, and to configure appearance based on toast level.

methods.name: OnInitialized
methods.description: Initializes the component, subscribing to toast show/hide events.

methods.name: ShowToast
methods.description: Handles display of toast messages, setting appearance based on level and making the toast visible.

methods.name: BuildToastSettings
methods.description: Configures CSS classes and heading based on the toast level.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Unsubscribes from toast events to prevent memory leaks.
